title: Willing Mind

sources.title: Slack-Skinned Head
markers: on a desk west of the head

summary: Insert into the Mind-Archive Interface to hear the Willing Mind.

fields.Use: Insert the brain into the interface in the Necrotic Laboratory to speak through the Slack-Skinned Head. The dialogue concerns a singer recruited by Gortash and includes a Bard response.
fields.Acquisition: Desk west of the Mind-Archive Interface in the Mind Flayer Colony.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
